# TEDxTU Wien

> TEDxTU Wien (also written TEDxTUWien or TEDx TU Wien) is an independently organized TED event (operated under license from TED) at TU Wien, Vienna. The 10th anniversary edition takes place on 14 November 2027; time, venue, theme, speakers and tickets are still to be announced. The 9th edition took place on 22 November 2026 in the Kuppelsaal, Karlsplatz 13, 1040 Vienna.

## Pages

- [English site](https://www.tedxtuwien.at/): the 2027 edition (details to be announced), past events, FAQ, newsletter
- [Deutsche Seite](https://www.tedxtuwien.at/de/): the same content in German
- [2026 recap](https://www.tedxtuwien.at/2026/): speakers, hosts, performers, program and partners of the 2026 edition
- [Team](https://www.tedxtuwien.at/team/): the organizing team

## Facts

- Next edition: 14 November 2027 (10th anniversary), everything else to be announced
- Last edition: 22 November 2026, Kuppelsaal, TU Wien main building, Karlsplatz 13, 1040 Vienna
- Contact: office@tedxtuwien.at
- Past talks: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC4RcJoERDV6iVhVZpNMxJvQ
